news_title: HKT Limited and HKT Trust (collectively "HKT") and PCCW Limited ("PCCW")  – 2026 Annual Budget for the audit and non-audit services to be rendered in fiscal year ending 31 December 2026
news_content:
In compliance with the Corporate Governance Code set out in Appendix C1 to the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, the Audit Committees of HKT and PCCW are tasked to review and monitor the provision of audit and non-audit services by an external auditor to ensure that the external auditor’s independence and objectivity are not impaired.

For the purpose of preparing the 2026 annual budget for submission to the HKT Audit Committee and PCCW Audit Committee, all business units and corporate functions which wish to engage PricewaterhouseCoopers or KPMG, the external auditor for the provision of audit and non-audit services in 2026 are requested to submit the following completed documents to the following designated staff by 10 October 2025:

HKT Group

(A) Tax services – Neville Li (Group Tax – ext. 38203) / Salina Kwong (Group Tax – ext. 37026) – please submit (1) a summary of all entities’ budgets on the “2026 Tax Services Summary” form for each external auditor and (2) “HKT – Annual General Pre-Approval Request” form
(B) All other services – Cindy Yu (Group Finance – ext. 34282) / Michelle Chan (Group Finance – ext. 30747) – please submit the “HKT – Annual General Pre-Approval Request” form

Pccw Group (excluding HKT)

(A) Tax services – Neville Li (Group Tax – ext. 38203) / Salina Kwong (Group Tax – ext. 37026) – please submit (1) a summary of all entities’ budgets on the “2026 Tax Services Summary” form for each external auditor and (2) “PCCW – Annual General Pre-Approval Request” form
(B) All other services – Molly Ho (Group Finance – ext. 36331) / Angel Chiang (Group Finance – ext. 38865) – please submit the “PCCW – Annual General Pre-Approval Request” form

Prior to engagement of an external auditor for such services, business units and corporate functions are reminded that separate management approvals must be obtained through completion of the External Consultant Requisition Form.

Any 2026 budgets which are not submitted to the designated staff by 10 October 2025 for the annual general pre-approval process described above and any engagements which exceed the scope or budget per the annual general pre-approval, will need to be separately submitted for Audit Committee Specific Pre-approval at the relevant time.

Please contact any of the above Group Finance or Group Tax colleagues if you have any questions on the above.

Kind regards,


Vanessa Cheung
Group General Counsel and Company Secretary
